profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at OpenGov Inc.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I am a developer who works on Microsoft Word.

positions.title: Intern Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I developed two small features for the Office 2010 version of Microsoft Word.

positions.title: Co-op Software Developer
positions.description: I work on RSA's WebCRD application, which is an award-winning Web-to-Print solution for enterprise customers. Their system automates the submission and ticketing (option selection) of documents to print centers.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer (Co-op)
positions.description: I develop software testing tools for use with Goodrich's imaging systems, including the camera used on the U-2 spy plane.

positions.title: Computer Science Student Lab Instructor
positions.description: I teach a lab, grade the lab, and tutor. Some of my students read the lad directions and earn good grades. Most of them don't read the directions, however, and they earn themselves bad grades. It's really that simple, too.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created a customizable report generator using Visual C++ and MFC.  Applied software design patterns to increase the extensibility of the report generator application.  Connected MFC applications to a MS SQL Server Express database with ADO and ODBC technologies
